When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of Jesus.
And when the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of James, and Salome, got spices, so that they might come and put them on him.
過了安息日，抹大拉的馬利亞和雅各的母親馬利亞並撒羅米，買了香膏要去膏耶穌的身體。
Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.
And very early after dawn on the first day of the week, they came at the time of the coming up of the sun to the place where the body had been put.
七日的第一日清早，出太陽的時候，她們來到墳墓那裡，
They were asking one another, “Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?”
And they were saying among themselves, Who will get the stone rolled away from the door for us?
彼此說：「誰給我們把石頭從墓門滾開呢？」
But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.
And looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back; and it was of great size.
那石頭原來很大，她們抬頭一看，卻見石頭已經滾開了。
When they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
And when they went in, they saw a young man seated on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were full of wonder.
她們進了墳墓，看見一個少年人坐在右邊，穿著白袍，就甚驚恐。
But he said to them, “Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here! See the place where they put Him.

And he said to them, Do not be troubled: you are looking for Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been put to death on the cross; he has come back from the dead; he is not here: see, the place where they put him!
那少年人對她們說：「不要驚恐！你們尋找那釘十字架的拿撒勒人耶穌，他已經復活了，不在這裡。請看安放他的地方。
But go, tell His disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him, just as He told you.’”
But go, say to his disciples and to Peter, He goes before you into Galilee: there you will see him, as he said to you.
你們可以去告訴他的門徒和彼得，說：『他在你們以先往加利利去。在那裡你們要見他，正如他從前所告訴你們的。』」
So the women left the tomb and ran away, trembling and bewildered. And in their fear they did not say a word to anyone.
And they went out quickly from the place, because fear and great wonder had come on them: and they said nothing to anyone, because they were full of fear that...
她們就出來，從墳墓那裡逃跑，又發抖又驚奇，甚麼也不告訴人，因為她們害怕。
Early on the first day of the week, after Jesus had risen, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom He had driven out seven demons.
Now when he came back from the dead early on the first day of the week, he went first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had sent out seven evil spirits.
在七日的第一日清早，耶穌復活了，就先向抹大拉的馬利亞顯現。（耶穌從她身上曾趕出七個鬼。）
She went and told those who had been with Him, who were mourning and weeping.
She went and gave news of it to those who had been with him, while they were sorrowing and weeping.
她去告訴那向來跟隨耶穌的人；那時他們正哀慟哭泣。
And when they heard that Jesus was alive and she had seen Him, they did not believe it.
And they, when it came to their ears that he was living, and had been seen by her, had no belief in it.
他們聽見耶穌活了，被馬利亞看見，卻是不信。
After this, Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them as they walked along in the country.
And after these things he was seen in another form by two of them, while they were walking on their way into the country.
這事以後，門徒中間有兩個人往鄉下去。走路的時候，耶穌變了形像，向他們顯現。
And they went back and reported it to the rest, but they did not believe them either.
And they went away and gave news of it to the rest; and they had no belief in what was said.
他們就去告訴其餘的門徒；其餘的門徒也是不信。
Later, as they were eating, Jesus appeared to the Eleven and rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they did not believe those who had seen Him after He had risen.

And later he was seen by the eleven themselves while they were taking food; and he said sharp words to them because they had no faith and their hearts were hard, and because they had no belief in those who had seen him after he had come back from the dead.
後來，十一個門徒坐席的時候，耶穌向他們顯現，責備他們不信，心裡剛硬，因為他們不信那些在他復活以後看見他的人。
And He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to every creature.
And he said to them, Go into all the world, and give the good news to everyone.
他又對他們說：「你們往普天下去，傳福音給萬民（萬民：原文是凡受造的）聽。
Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
He who has faith and is given baptism will get salvation; but he who has not faith will be judged.
信而受洗的，必然得救；不信的，必被定罪。
And these signs will accompany those who believe: In My name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
And these signs will be with those who have faith: in my name they will send out evil spirits; and they will make use of new languages;
信的人必有神蹟隨著他們，就是奉我的名趕鬼；說新方言；
they will pick up snakes with their hands, and if they drink any deadly poison, it will not harm them; they will lay their hands on the sick, and they will be made well.”
They will take up snakes, and if there is poison in their drink, it will do them no evil; they will put their hands on those who are ill, and they will get well.
手能拿蛇；若喝了甚麼毒物，也必不受害；手按病人，病人就必好了。」
After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, He was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.
So then the Lord Jesus, after he had said these words to them, was taken up into heaven and took his seat at the right hand of God.
主耶穌和他們說完了話，後來被接到天上，坐在神的右邊。
And they went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked through them, confirming His word by the signs that accompanied it.
And they went out, preaching everywhere, the Lord working with them, and giving witness to the word by the signs which came after. So be it.
門徒出去，到處宣傳福音。主和他們同工，用神蹟隨著，證實所傳的道。阿們！
